raw.buffDescription: The Attacker begins the fight with 15 Combo Charges. Each Basic Attack hit removes 1 Charge, and activating a Special Attack resets them.\nIf the Charges reach 0, they are reset, and the Attacker is inflicted with a Degeneration Passive dealing 100% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage over 4 seconds.
